title: Narrative bind (story lock before DCF)
description: Written by Agent 5 before valuation_model.json on harness >= 3.0.0. status=locked is the compute-bind gate.

stage_fit.description: REQUIRED on harness >= 3.3.0 (Python gate) when a stage is named: why the story matches the stage. A wrong-stage story is a fail, not a variant.

buyer.description: REQUIRED on harness >= 3.3.0 (Python gate). The marginal buyer. public_diversified/ipo_or_public_buyer: illiquidity_discount must be 0. private_undiversified: total_beta=true and illiquidity_discount>0. vc_pe: ke_stepdown.

illiquidity_discount.description: Fraction of value. 0 for a diversified public buyer; >0 for a private undiversified buyer.

ke_stepdown.description: REQUIRED for vc_pe (>=20 chars): how cost of equity steps down toward the market at recap/IPO.

market_contest.description: REQUIRED on harness >= 3.3.0 (Python gate). Accept market rf/ERP/weights; contest the company cash-flow path.

option_screens.description: REQUIRED on harness >= 3.3.0 (Python gate) for contingent_claim or real_options. Opportunities are not options.

distressed_call.description: REQUIRED on harness >= 3.3.0 (Python gate) for the distressed_call overlay. The liquidation call replaces DCF equity; it is never added on top.

iv_playbook.description: REQUIRED on harness >= 3.1.0 (Python gate). One primary id from valuation_router.md: mature_operating | financial_service | real_estate | young_startup. Distressed and cyclical are overlays, not primary ids.

overlays.description: Stacked overlays: cyclical | distressed | intangibles_sbc | em | truncation | sotp_users | growth_assets | macro_neutral | real_options | distressed_call | asset_based_floor | private_buyer | value_enhancement. Overlays do not replace the one primary iv_playbook.

story.description: REQUIRED on harness >= 3.2.0 (Python gate). paragraph states the business story (>=20 chars).

3p.description: REQUIRED on harness >= 3.2.0. possible/plausible/probable must each be a non-empty list; possible strands are not in the DCF base.

map.description: REQUIRED on harness >= 3.2.0. Each key names a real input present in valuation_model (assumptions / wacc_buildup / terminal_consistency / roic_identity / explicit_forecast / street_bind); the value is the story sentence that drives it.
